key_decisions.rationale: Retains the narrator’s broad description; renders the uncertain fist idiom contextually and flags its uncertainty in a note.
key_decisions.before: For the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they wash their hands carefully, holding to the tradition of the elders.
key_decisions.after: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, do not eat unless they wash their hands in the prescribed way, holding to the tradition of the elders.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the marketplace context and all four objects, including couches present in the pinned text.
key_decisions.before: And when they come from the marketplace, they do not eat unless they wash. There are many other traditions they have received and hold, including washings of cups, pitchers, and copper vessels.
key_decisions.after: When they come from the marketplace, they do not eat without washing. They also observe many other traditions they have received, such as washing cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and dining couches.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And from the marketplace, unless they wash, they do not eat, and there are many other things which they have received to hold—washings of cups and pitchers and copper vessels.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders Greek as the religious-cultural contrast in context while retaining the specific Syrophoenician identity.
key_decisions.before: The woman was Greek, Syrophoenician by birth. She kept asking him to cast the demon out of her daughter.
key_decisions.after: The woman was a Gentile, Syrophoenician by birth. She begged him to drive the demon out of her daughter.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now the woman was a Greek, Syrophoenician by birth, and she was asking him to cast the demon out of her daughter.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains first, satisfaction, bread, and the exclusionary dog image without cushioning it as affectionate puppies.
key_decisions.before: Jesus said to her, “Let the children be fed first, because it is not right to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
key_decisions.after: He said to her, “Let the children eat their fill first. It is not right to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to her, “Let the children first be fed, for it is not right to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
